what: Several photo columns flow endlessly vertically — the part appends one more copy of each column’s contents to stack two sets, and each set rises straight by its own height (-100%) over 60 seconds, repeating seamlessly (starts after .5 seconds). Even columns come down in reverse so neighboring columns flow in a staggered way — for the photo collection columns beside the About text.

options.[data-fx-part=col]: Flowing column — put one set of photos (figure) inside. Height comes from the consuming css (longer than the panel height)
options.reverse: Columns that flow in reverse — default even, ’odd’ for odd, ’none’ for all upward

from.where: index.html .sn-concept__images (original concept section .images: loop-images-vertical 60s linear .5s infinite, second row reverse)

note: The flow is a CSS animation so it doesn’t stutter even when scripts are heavy. It runs off-screen too — the original does the same
